"""Bounded ACF-exception feasibility review, no runtime or financial inputs."""
import ast

BASE=ROOT/'research/S013/experiments'
OUT=ROOT/'.tmp/ex055-method-review'
JSON_NAMES={'metadata.json','plan.json','geometry.json','protocol.json','decision.json','authorization.json'}

def digest(path):
